column4: Root cause of checkout blocker: shipping method has no rates
column5: Settings > Shipping: 'Carrier Wise Shipping Cost' is selected, but Shipping Carriers shows 'No carriers configured yet.' Only one zone exists ('USA', destination 'All countries, California, wertg', $0.00, 'No rates'). Result: storefront says 'No home-delivery rate is available' for every address.
column6: Short term: switch to Flat Rate (or Area Wise) and set a cost. Proper fix: create carriers (UPS/FedEx/USPS) with zone rates, clean the 'USA' zone destination.

column4: Pickup Point feature ON but no pickup points exist
column5: Features activation: 'Pickup Point Activation' = ON. Settings > Pickup Points: 'No pickup points found.' Checkout tells customers to 'choose pickup' with nothing to choose.
column6: Either add at least one pickup point or turn the feature OFF; hide the pickup message when no points exist.

column4: Debug mode enabled and environment = local
column5: System > Server Status: Environment 'local', Debug Mode 'Enabled'. Any PHP error shows a full stack trace (paths, queries, env values) to visitors.
column6: Set APP_ENV=production and APP_DEBUG=false before any public launch.

column4: Admin account uses a weak password
column5: Master admin password is a simple 9-digit number sequence. No 2FA, no reCAPTCHA on login.
column6: Change to a strong password, add 2FA for admin/staff, enable reCAPTCHA + rate-limit on login.

column4: Emails will not reach customers
column5: SMTP host 127.0.0.1 port 2525 (local mail catcher), no username/password, from-address noreply@stautoparts.local.
column6: Configure a real provider (SES, Mailgun, SendGrid, Microsoft 365) with a verified domain; set from-address on the real domain; send a test mail.

column4: 'Total Revenue' counts cancelled, refunded and unpaid orders
column5: Dashboard shows $17,702.37 = sum of all 52 orders. Paid orders only (8 orders) = $896.69. 20 pending/unpaid orders alone = $9,670.81.
column6: Revenue = paid orders minus refunds. Show unpaid/pending value as a separate card.

column4: No order status workflow guard
column5: Order #ORD6AEB1B00882E7 went Pending > Processing > Shipped > Delivered > Cancelled within 7 minutes; it is 'Cancelled' + 'Refunded'. Export shows 10 orders 'Delivered' but 'Unpaid' and 2 'Shipped' but 'Unpaid'.
column6: Add allowed-transition rules (e.g. Delivered cannot go to Cancelled; use Return/Refund instead). Warn when shipping unpaid non-COD orders. Refund via Stripe API, not just a label.

column4: PHP limits too low for bulk import and exports
column5: Upload Max Filesize 2M, Post Max Size 8M, Max Execution Time 30 s. Bulk Import page says 'Max 5MB' so files 2–5 MB will fail. Exporting 761k products in 30 s is not possible.
column6: Raise upload_max_filesize/post_max_size (e.g. 64M) and run import/export as queued jobs with progress.

column4: Queue has failed and pending jobs
column5: Queue driver 'database': Pending Jobs 2, Failed Jobs 1. Emails/imports using the queue will silently stop if no worker runs.
column6: Run a supervised queue worker (Supervisor/systemd) + scheduler cron; add a Failed Jobs screen with retry.

column4: APP_URL does not match the server address
column5: APP URL = http://localhost/new-steve while site runs on http://192.168.130.54/new-steve. Links in emails, sitemap and invoices may point to localhost.
column6: Set APP_URL to the real domain for each environment.

column4: Admin product pages are very heavy
column5: All Products page 4.7 MB (3.6 s); Product edit 2.9 MB; Product create 2.9 MB — every category (21,300) is printed in a dropdown.
column6: Use an AJAX searchable select (Select2/Tom Select) for category/brand/seller.

column4: Settings page is 21 MB

column4: Search Categories page is 7.6 MB
column5: Lists every category (21,300) as available options on one page.

column4: Product form is missing key auto-parts fields
column5: Edit form has: name, price, old price, shipping cost, commission, category, brand, seller, stock, badge, type, status, featured, a single year/make/model, tabs, description, images. No editable part number/SKU, no OEM/cross-reference numbers, no weight/dimensions (needed for carrier rates), no SEO meta title/description/slug, only ONE vehicle fitment.
column6: Add: part number/SKU, OEM & interchange numbers, weight + dimensions, condition, warranty, SEO fields, and a multi-row fitment editor (year range + make + model + engine).

column4: Stock data looks like placeholder values
column5: Out of Stock: 0. Low (1–5): 401,429 of 761,107 products. Many products have stock = 1.
